These same three examples now author a default full-run flow: fresh handoff,
native CLI solve, strict returned-result resolution, physics and benchmark views.
The Human confirmed the short first-trial settings below. Source authoring is
not native execution or scientific acceptance; joint runtime/native admission
remains pending. OrcaPen supplies the selected neutral `physical_layer` carrier
on Entity and stack metadata; SCGSim owns the common interpretation. OrcaPen owns the
layouts and notebooks; SCGSim owns preparation, transactions and result readers.
Optional model-only inspection remains distinct from solving.

## System and representation

- **Concentric system:** annular Signal pads on both die faces connect through
  the central hollow TSV. Four surrounding TSVs connect the two separate Ground
  planes. The Signal opening and bore are not Ground.
- **Ground-stitched CPW:** a through Signal reaches the two exterior cuts; two
  rows of TSVs stitch top and back Ground. It is a full 3D system, not a uniform
  Q2D section or a claim of optimal TSV spacing.
- **Model:** face metal/landings use Thin Film. Hollow TiN walls and cut Silicon
  remain finite Solid. The physical source thickness and material identity stay
  recorded; the backend handles declared source-to-effective Z mapping.

The canonical factories in `orcapen_sc_pdk.cells.simulation.scgsim.tsv` own shapes,
holes, source occurrences and contact intent. Concrete dimensions,
Net membership and enclosure controls live in each notebook.

## Workflow and expected output

| Example | Human-confirmed first trial |
| --- | --- |
| Q3D C/G | 5 GHz; maximum 3 passes; 1% convergence; AC R/L off |
| HFSS Eigenmode | minimum 1 GHz; 3 modes; maximum 3 passes; delta-frequency 1%; no junction, load or EPR |
| Driven Terminal Wave | Broadband 3–8 GHz; Fast 11 points; maximum 3 passes; delta-S 0.02; original ordered o1/o2 references, no renormalization, de-embed 0 |

All three resolve minimum passes 1, consecutive converged passes 1 and
refinement 30%. The three-pass endpoint is a short trial, not a success or
accuracy threshold. Geometry, materials, enclosure, Nets and ports are retained.

1. For `run`, build the canonical layout/getter inputs and export a fresh source
   witness; preserve hollow walls, substrate holes and the explicit Nets.
2. Prepare a new portable handoff with the selected complete run control.
3. Invoke the full-solve CLI, then use `resolve_results`, `show_all_results`,
   `physics_results` and `simulation_benchmark` on its actual returned artifacts.
4. For `analyze_handoff`, select an explicit returned root in a fresh kernel.
   Skip factory/getter/GDS/preparation/CLI entirely; do not silently pick a run.

`prepare_handoff` stops at portable inputs, and `source` stops at source facts.
Separately, `build_model` passes `run_control=None` and uses the checkpoint's
real `--prepare-only` model-only transaction; `inspect_model` calls
`resolve_prepared_model` on an explicit returned model. Neither is an available
Model+Setup/reuse workflow. No invented flag or helper fills that gap.

Inspect the actual body/sheet and assignment records, together with the saved
project and necessary companions. Preserve inconclusive contact or
boundary queries as unknown. Keep writable Human inspection copies separate
from hash-bound producer files.

::: {.callout-note title="Authoring is not execution evidence"}
The full-run branches show actual C/G, mode or Terminal network results only
after a real solve and strict resolution. Model-only readback cannot substitute
for them. Nonconvergence, native errors and result missingness remain visible;
there are no fabricated results, retries or accuracy claims. Terminal/derived
impedance is not modal Wave Port Zo. No junction, EPR or new source load is added.
:::

These canonical sources and clean notebooks are a local **CONVERGING**
candidate. Rendering them does not execute their cells; older Solid models are
not outputs of the current mixed Thin Film/Solid examples.
